title: Freightliner Cascadia Custom Built Hi-Tensile Aluminium FUPS Compliant Bullbar with Straight Pipes #17
description: Freightliner Cascadia FUPS Compliant custom built polished high tensile aluminium Bullbar, Custom contoured heavy duty extra depth main channel with provision for Active Brake Assist and Adaptive Cruise Control. Heavy duty box uprights with combination daylight running indicator and park light LED lights in main channel. High tensile 6mm wall polished aluminium tube recessed welded into the box uprights, no but welds plus provision for driving lights. Custom built light weight high tensile aluminium backing plate with tow 35mm tow pin. Cascadia branding embossed in end plates. Driving light mounts to customer requirements.
